title: Organization Evaluation
description: Output format for the Terramedic curation pipeline. Each evaluation assesses a candidate environmental organization for inclusion in the database.

country.description: Country where the organization is headquartered (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2).

registration_info.description: Registration number or ID if publicly available.

description.description: Brief description of the organization's mission and work.

image_url.description: URL to the organization's logo or representative image.

sdg_alignment.description: Which SDGs (13, 14, 15) the organization's work aligns with, and the evidence for each.

evidence.description: Brief explanation of how the org's work aligns with this SDG.

evidence_of_work.description: Concrete activities demonstrating the organization does real environmental work.

activity.description: Description of the activity or project.

date.description: Date or date range (approximate is fine).

source_url.description: URL to a source confirming this activity.

accessibility.description: How people can engage with this organization.

volunteer_url.description: URL to volunteer signup or opportunities page.

toolkit_url.description: URL to toolkits, petitions, or action guides.

categories.description: Which Terramedic pathways this org fits into.

evidence_score.description: Overall assessment of the organization's legitimacy and impact.

score.description: 0 = no evidence, 1 = minimal, 2 = some, 3 = moderate, 4 = strong, 5 = exceptional.

rationale.description: Explanation of why this score was given.

curator_notes.description: Additional context for the human reviewer.

flags.description: Issues or uncertainties the curator wants the reviewer to check.

recommendation.description: Curator's recommendation. Use needs_review when uncertain.

evaluated_by.description: The AI model used to produce this evaluation (e.g., claude-opus-4-6).
